name: Jesus As A Friend
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love, mutual care, and loyalty even in difficult times, as a friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity (Proverbs 17:17). Jesus exemplifies the highest form of friendship by laying down His life for His friends (John 15:13) and calls His followers friends when they obey His commands (John 15:14). Genuine friendship requires active kindness and sharpening one another’s character (Proverbs 18:24; 27:17), showing that Jesus is not only a friend who sacrifices but also one who faithfully strengthens and guides His people.
